title: Living room with pool
description: An open-plan living area with sofas around coffee tables, a round dining table, a grand piano and a bar, opening through glass doors onto a sunroom and an outdoor pool.

tasks.text: Find the small vase between the two table lamps on the wooden console that also holds a cup. Push the vase 20 cm along the console, away from the cup and toward the nearer lamp, leaving it upright on the console.

locatorSteps.label: Push the small vase 20 cm away from the cup
Leave the vase upright on the console

tasks.text: Slide open the glass door between the living room and sunroom. Pick up the cup beside the vase on the indoor bar, carry it through the sunroom to the pool terrace, and set it upright on the round side table beside the pool lounge chair.

locatorSteps.label: Slide open the glass door to the sunroom
Lift the cup from the bar and carry it through
Set the cup upright on the poolside table

tasks.text: At the grand piano, press and release one key at a time. Play middle C, E, G, the next C up, B, A, G, E, then middle C. Let the last key rise after the ninth note.

locatorSteps.label: Press and release middle C
Press and release E
Press and release G
Press and release the next C up
Press and release B
Press and release A
Press and release G
Press and release E
Finish on middle C and release it

tasks.text: Find the pair of glass display cabinets on the south wall and use the cabinet at the west end, nearest the wooden console with the cup. Swing open its outer glass door, the one nearest the corner, then close it and let go so it stays shut.

locatorSteps.label: Swing open the glass door nearest the corner
Close the same door and release it

tasks.text: At the bar with two lamps and a vase, use the end drawer nearest the piano, directly below a table lamp. Pull the drawer 25 cm out toward the room, push it fully closed, then let go.

locatorSteps.label: Pull the end drawer nearest the piano out 25 cm
Push it fully closed and release it

tasks.text: At the grand piano, pull the bench 20 cm straight away from the keyboard toward the west wall behind the bench. Keep it upright and let it come to rest there.

locatorSteps.label: Pull the bench 20 cm back from the keyboard
Leave it upright facing the piano

tasks.text: At the sofa nearest the piano, lift the vase off the side table at the sofa’s piano-side end. Set it upright on the floor immediately north of that table, toward the piano, and release it so it stands on its own.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the vase from the sofa’s piano-side end
Set it upright on the floor just north of this table

tasks.text: Lift the small bowl from the coffee table that also holds a vase in front of the east sofa. Carry it to the coffee table near the piano and release it upright inside the larger bowl at the center of that table.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the small bowl from the east sofa’s coffee table
Release it upright inside the larger bowl near the piano

tasks.text: Find the potted plant on the dark round table with the cups. Turn the pot halfway around in its original spot, then release it so it stays upright with the opposite side facing you.

locatorSteps.label: Rotate the pot half a turn in place
Release it upright in the same spot

tasks.text: At the dark round table with the potted plant, find the chair on the east side, between the table and the room’s central seating area. Push it 25 cm straight toward the table and leave its seat tucked under the tabletop with the chair upright.

locatorSteps.label: Push the east chair 25 cm toward the round table
Leave the seat tucked under the tabletop

mobility.basis: Structural source joint inventory; free-body movement and task success not tested by this export.

previewPolicy.method: Preserve source geometry; exclude exterior backdrops from initial framing. Oversized architecture crossing a source-derived room footprint is partitioned into room/backdrop triangles with interpolated UVs and normals.
previewPolicy.footprintBasis: Main room, pool-side and sunroom floor extents (v302,v656,v1706,v758), with 20 cm wall allowance; source exterior grounds retained as backdrop.

jointCouplings.method: Source zero-offset linear equalities, evaluated relative to each joint qpos0; common range intersection.

referenceImagePolicy: Full-resolution WebP previews; quality 98 with lossless fallback below 38 dB PSNR. Original images remain in the linked source pictures.zip.
